questions.q: What turns liquid water into water vapour in the water cycle?
questions.why: The sun heats oceans, lakes, and rivers, turning liquid water into water vapour.

questions.q: If about 100 litres of rain falls on a hill, how much runs off to rivers?
questions.why: The script says roughly 60 litres runs off to rivers.

questions.q: Why does a wet shirt dry on a sunny day?
options: The water evaporates into the air
The water soaks into the soil
questions.why: The sun makes the water evaporate into the air, so the shirt dries.
